title: Fix Location Steppers Rendering Outside Property Row Grid in Detail Panel
description: Location steppers are rendering in a new row at the left side of the detail panel instead of inside the property-row grid. Ensure all stepper/slider/input controls in the detail panel always render properly within the property-row grid layout.
summary: Added `showLabel` prop to all 20 Stepper components that were missing it in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx. Without `showLabel`, Steppers rendered as bare elements outside the Label/property-row grid, causing them to appear in a new row at the left. All 36 Steppers in the file now have `showLabel`. All 105 tests pass.
